model: INBACMID004I000 (Midea commercial and VRF BACnet server, up to 4 units)
equipment_type: VRF BACnet gateway (up to 4 indoor units)
applies_to: Midea commercial and VRF systems on the XYE bus, up to 4 indoor units.
summary: Intesis BACnet server on the Midea XYE bus that serves BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP for up to four indoor units. It publishes seven gateway-wide commands that act on all units, then one block of 17 objects per indoor unit at (unit index x 100) + offset: on/off, mode, setpoint, fan, swing, room temperature, error code, communication error, remote lock and operating-mode force.
notes: Indoor unit instance = (xxx x 100) + offset, xxx = unit index 1-4 set in MAPS. Unit 1 (100-104) is shown; units 2-4 repeat the block at 200, 300 and 400.
Object names start with Uxx, where xx is the indoor unit address (1-64).
BO 0-3, MO 0-1 and AO 0 act on all indoor units at once.
Temperatures can be shown in °C or °F (17-30 °C / 62-88 °F setpoint range).
Different product from the one-unit INBACMID001I100, which is listed separately.

source.title: Intesis BACnet Server - Midea Commercial & VRF User Manual (INBACMID004I000)

integration.summary: Wire the Midea XYE outdoor unit X/Y terminals to Port A (A4 X, A3 Y), configure the units in Intesis MAPS and send the project, then map each indoor unit's objects from its (index x 100) block.

minimum_points.name: Uxx_Communication Error IU
minimum_points.why: Unit offline on the XYE bus

integration.enable: No enable point is documented. Uxx_Remote control lock_C (BO 102) locks the unit's remote controller.
setup: Default device instance 246; device name and instance can be changed in MAPS.
BACnet IP uses the ETH port; BACnet MS/TP uses Port B (B1 -, B2 +, B3 SNGD) with a 120-ohm terminator switch.
gotchas: Gateway-wide objects (BO 0-3, MO 0-1, AO 0) change every indoor unit; map per-unit objects for single-zone control.
